node.statement: By lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger, the fixed W has W.c0_cb=c0, W.L>=L^0, W.K3>=max{K_3^0,1,W.L,W.c0_cb*W.L}, W.e_cross<=min{e_cross^0,e_3}, and the universal D_*=max{1,D_0,D_1,D_2,D_3} satisfies D_*>=1; W also carries all smallness bounds required by lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation.
